title: One app for your daily worship
intro: {appName} brings your Salah, Qaza, Zikr and Qur'an together, so you can see your whole day of worship in one place.

salah.label: Salah
salah.title: See your day of Salah at a glance
salah.text: Tap each Salah as you pray it. Your progress ring, streak and calendar fill in, without guilt when a day doesn't go to plan.
salah.shotAlt: Tracker screen: 2 of 5 obligatory Salah logged, a 2-day streak, and rings for Witr, adhkar, Qaza and khatm.

qaza.label: Qaza
qaza.title: Turn missed Salah into a plan
qaza.text: Estimate what you missed, pick a daily pace you can keep, and watch the number fall, with a finish date that updates as you go.
qaza.shotAlt: Qaza screen: 25 remaining, 62 made up, 71% complete and an estimated finish date.

zikr.label: Zikr
zikr.title: Adhkar for every part of your day
zikr.text: Guided sessions for the morning, evening, after Salah and before sleep, each zikr shown with its source hadith.

points.duas: {count, plural, one {# dua} other {# duas}} from Hisnul Muslim

zikr.shotAlt: Zikr screen with favorites, search, My adhkar and categories like Morning and Evening Adhkar.

quran.label: Qur'an
quran.title: Read, listen and practise the Qur'an
quran.text: The full Qur'an offline with word-by-word and tajweed colours, a khatm plan, and an on-device listener to practise your recitation.
quran.shotAlt: Qur'an screen with continue reading for Al-Baqarah, shortcuts to search, pages, juz, learn and khatm.
